claim: On held-out development tasks, a fixed label-blind code comparator trained with C0 continuation-cost weights can yield lower complete-cascade selection regret than the identical comparator using ordinary CE or normalized execution-gap weights. Fixed scope, no sweep.
credit: Expand the registered DS1 baseline feasibility check to all 850 jobs. For each valid strict unique queried edge, fix right/wrong and rerun the remaining actual C0 from identical prefix/seed/budget. Baseline continuation may be reused only when exactly verified. Arithmetic mean of signed delta across all occurrences per (task,unordered pair), then positive part; gap = mean of normalized execution score differences on SAME occurrences. Every other admissible supervised pair gets zero increment. Compute task-local artifacts independently, training fold receives only task-local training partitions. Assert 52-job sample reproduces prior row values.
arms: one row per unique eligible pair; uniform=1, gap=1+mean(shared gap), terminal=1+max(0,mean(signed delta)), shuffled=permute terminal increments within task x exposure class (0,1,2-3,4+) with fixed seed 20261108. Normalize arm weights per training task mean=1; task-balanced loss (same total weight per training task). Identical samples, feature encoder, optimizer budget and initialization across arms. No exposed task/file IDs, origin, confidence, true scores or terminal costs as inference features.
split: 26 outer leave-one-task-out folds, heldout label/weight files never enter fit; remove training pairs sharing byte-identical/canonical AST code with heldout; report counts and residual near-duplicate risk. Fixed features/hyperparameters per design, no test-driven tuning. Allow only deterministic label-free preprocessing of target input at inference. Seal predicted winner for every eligible unseen pair before scorer reads outcomes.
cost: Local compute and already executed candidates. No paid endpoints or rentals, no new candidate executions. Source downloads allowed for a compact frozen public encoder if practical. Record actual training, wall time, bytes, count of fits and features/truncation. An unavailable or weak baseline restricts claims.
evaluation: Use all 850 jobs of actual corrected_tournament with original .7 validity/confidence by pair and same max 13 reads; only change winning direction when gate accepts. Rerun adaptive trajectories per arm before joining heldout execution labels. Uniform ties and task-macro scoring, reference unchanged original C0 and DS1 flags. Also evaluate on the 3 available GPT acceptance masks as prespecified sensitivity (same out-of-fold predictions); these are reused task corpus and repeated masks, not new test data. Preserve costs, ties, failures and swap consistency.
decision: Primary normalized gain = R(uniform)-R(terminal). Also R(gap)-R(terminal), R(shuffled)-R(terminal), R(actual C0)-R(terminal). Report paired task bootstrap 10000 at seed 20261108093, leave-one-task-out sensitivities (training folds overlap; intervals conditional on predictions), task/size and hit metrics. A method claim needs >=.01 primary gain, stable leave-one signs, and improvement over gap and shuffled; a usable replacement must also beat C0 at matched budget and be confirmed on fresh tasks. If representation/weight signal too weak, close this pilot without tuning on outcomes. Judge-only remains a research priority, not a validated C0 replacement.
roles: separate label-derived credit builder, supervised comparator trainer, independent replay evaluator, lead research roadmap/review
